repair_tips: Check charging port for dust before replacing parts; Swollen battery must be replaced only by a service centre; Cracked screen can be replaced at an authorised service centre
hazards: Lithium battery: fire risk if punctured; Cobalt compounds in battery; Flame retardants in plastics
recycler: Drop at an authorised e-waste collection centre (see KSPCB list)

repair_tips: Slow laptop: replace hard disk with an SSD; Clean fan and replace thermal paste if it overheats; Weak battery can be replaced separately
hazards: Lithium battery pack; Flame retardants in casing and PCB; Small amounts of lead in older solder
recycler: Drop at an authorised e-waste collection centre (see KSPCB list)

repair_tips: Check the cable first: most charger faults are a broken cable; Never open a charger that is plugged in
hazards: Capacitors can hold charge even when unplugged; Flame retardants in plastic
recycler: Drop at an authorised e-waste collection centre (see KSPCB list)

repair_tips: Broken wire near the jack can be re-soldered; Replace ear tips instead of the whole earphone
hazards: PVC cable coating releases toxic fumes if burnt
recycler: Drop at an authorised e-waste collection centre (see KSPCB list)

repair_tips: Clean keypad contacts with isopropyl alcohol; Replace the removable battery if backup is weak
hazards: Lithium battery; Flame retardants in plastics
recycler: Drop at an authorised e-waste collection centre (see KSPCB list)
